raw_content:
id: vuln-dectalk-tts-3600d8ac
languages:
  - yaml
message: "Vulnerable function dectalk uses HTTP instead of HTTPS for TTS API request."
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-31206
  cwe:
    - CWE-300
    - CWE-319
    - CWE-598
pattern: >
  function dectalk(...) {
  $1 = new URL('http://tts.cyzon.us/tts');
  $2
  }

pattern-not: >
  function dectalk(...) {
  $1 = new URL('https://tts.cyzon.us/tts');
  $2
  }
